title: Fleet Binding and Evidence Envelope
description: One fleet work-identity binding/evidence envelope: the exact repository, host, harness, and checkpoint coordinates that bind a live task-graph task to the concrete work that advanced it, per MVP-EXECUTION-DISPATCH-CONTRACT-20260909's identity rule and MVP_LANE_RESTART_PROMPT_20260910_R8.md's worklink field list. Every field is required; commit_sha carries an empty string only when the envelope records a planning/evidence checkpoint that is not yet backed by a specific commit.

project_id.description: logical task-universe namespace (task-graph project_id), e.g. "arbor"; not the GCP project id and not the tenant organization_id

task_id.description: the task-plan task canonical_name this envelope binds to, e.g. "MVP-FG-ID-ENVELOPE-SCHEMA-20260911"

host.description: the workstation the work was performed on

account_or_harness.description: the acting account or harness identity, e.g. "claude", "codex", or a service-account email

thread.description: the fleet thread or workflow that produced this artifact

absolute_worktree.description: absolute path of the worktree the work was done in; never a shared repository mirror

branch.description: the branch the work landed on

commit_sha.description: 40 lowercase hex characters (Git SHA-1) or 64 lowercase hex characters (Inarch BLAKE3 changeset ID) when this envelope is code-backed; empty string when it is not (e.g. a planning-only or evidence-only checkpoint with no accompanying commit)

pr_or_spec_ref.description: a pull-request URL or a canonical spec/section coordinate this envelope's work is governed by or delivered through

checkpoint_ref.description: a checkpoint file path, followed by the literal '#sha256=', followed by the 64 lowercase hex character SHA-256 digest of that checkpoint's exact bytes

measured_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when this envelope's coordinates were measured/recorded
